# UFIconnect

UFIconnect is a social network with personalized feeds, communities, messaging, videos, and job discovery at https://uficonnect.org.

## What It Is

UFIconnect helps people build profiles, share posts, message each other, join communities, discover creators and conversations, and find jobs, gigs, grants, events, and learning opportunities.

## Important Pages

- Home: https://uficonnect.org/
- Create an account: https://uficonnect.org/register
- Find professionals and communities: https://uficonnect.org/search
- Groups: https://uficonnect.org/groups
- Opportunities: https://uficonnect.org/opportunities
- Privacy policy: https://uficonnect.org/privacy

## Positioning

UFIconnect blends a social network with job hunting: personalized feeds, public profiles, communities, messaging, posts, likes, comments, videos, and opportunity discovery.

## Contact

Support: support@uficonnect.org
